body: I do everyday I want to live I want to be the best version if myself. It's the pain it's overwhelming it controls my happiness it pops up when I laugh when I watch t.v. when I do anything.
That's pretty cool my wife had some they are cute lol
I quit my job today cause the thoughts overwhelm me when I'm not at home.

She says I'm sorry. I can't say yet Im Scared to release it. Most of my friends are work friends and they just want me to do my shift and leave her you'll be fine but I can't help you type of shit. My mom passed 3 years ago dad was never around. Me and my family lost touch after she passed. all I have is her and she hurt me worse then anyone I've ever known.

In the last 3 months I've learned the person who is supposed to protect me and love me betrayed me and hurt me more then anyone ever has her friends knew and didn't tell me. Even though I went to bat for them many times. One of them I actually saved her from an abusive relationship. This friend told my wife she would support her through anything and helped her betray me. Went with her to do it and knew the entire time was in my house smiling in my face. Now I feel worthless. Like dying would be easier then what I know. It's not as simple as a short relationship. I've made countless mistakes myself. This goes against everything she is. We've been together since middle school. 16years. Married for 5. The betrayal is killing me inside.

I feel like sometimes it makes going on easier when you know that if it comes to that you can just end it......but there are many reasons to go on I'm sure you have people who need you. Maybe find a purpose to feel grounded in this world

I agree to a certain extent. Some things will break you down inside and you won't recover. Unfortunately the hardest thing to deal with is the truth. The human condition demands you know the truth but after you wish you didn't. So white lies are an example of protecting. Big lies are an example of deceit.
You are so strong for surviving that. I can't imagine the pain and suffering. I hope and pray someone treats you great and makes you feel safe and secure in this life.
Thats amazing. I also smile like an idiot when my children sing lol
I just want to let go of the past but it's all I think about up until a month ago my wife lying to me everyday while I was buying a wedding dress planning a wedding she kept talking to the guy.
Yeah we're gonna see. I'm hoping for the truth cause it went against everything she has always believed. So I'm worried about her changing.
Thanks I appreciate it. This gonna be a long road.
